# betterado_group (Data Source)

Looks up an Azure DevOps group by name (and optionally project).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "MyProject"
}

# Look up a group in a specific project.
data "betterado_group" "contributors" {
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "Contributors"
}

output "contributors_descriptor" {
  value = data.betterado_group.contributors.descriptor
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the group.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the group belongs to. If omitted, collection-level groups are searched.

### Read-Only

- `descriptor` (String) The descriptor of the group.
- `group_id` (String) The storage key UUID of the group.
- `id` (String) The descriptor of the group (used as the data source ID).
- `origin` (String) The origin of the group (e.g. vsts, aad).
- `origin_id` (String) The origin-specific identifier of the group.
